steps.text: Run `git clone https://github.com/hackerpug-ai/rnr-ai-elements.git /tmp/rnr-spike && cd /tmp/rnr-spike && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` — exits 0 and lists the `@rnr-ai-elements/docs` workspace package.

In /tmp/rnr-spike run `pnpm e2e:docs` — exits 0 in one run with `retries: 0`; the log shows the ordered chain (`registry:build`, `gallery:manifest`, the docs prebuild reporting 56 items and props resolved for 39/39 component items, astro build) and the spike flow (open site → ledger → component page → copy command via its button → fetch URL as JSON) passing.
Run `ls /tmp/rnr-spike/apps/docs/public/r/nativewind | wc -l` — prints 57 (56 item JSONs plus the per-engine registry.json index).
Run `git -C /tmp/rnr-spike check-ignore apps/docs/public/r/nativewind/conversation.json && echo IGNORED` — prints IGNORED: the served registry copy is gitignored, generated-only.

Run `pnpm --filter @rnr-ai-elements/docs build && pnpm --filter @rnr-ai-elements/docs preview`, open http://localhost:4321/registry — the table renders exactly 56 rows split 39/11/6, a note matching 'generated at build' mentioning public/r, both engine base URLs, and a copy button on every row's install command.

Open http://localhost:4321/components/conversation — h1 'Conversation', one-line description, chips for version/category/engines/Expo Go verdict, the install block FIRST containing `npx @react-native-reusables/cli@latest add https://rnraielements.com/r/nativewind/conversation.json` plus the labeled uniwind variant with a copy button, and full untruncated source in a Code view with no height limit.
Click the copy button on the conversation install block — the button shows a visible success state and pasting anywhere yields the exact displayed command.
Open http://localhost:4321/ — the home block shows 'NOT an npm package', counters 0.2.1 and 56 items split 39/11/6, one install command as selectable text, links to /registry and /components.

Copy the JSON URL out of the conversation install block and run `curl -s http://localhost:4321/r/nativewind/conversation.json` — JSON whose `name` is `conversation`, `files` non-empty, `registryDependencies` present, served from the same origin as the docs.

In /tmp/rnr-spike run `jq 'del(.items[] | select(.name == "shimmer"))' packages/registry/registry.json > /tmp/reg.json && mv /tmp/reg.json packages/registry/registry.json && pnpm registry:build && pnpm --filter @rnr-ai-elements/docs build` — exits non-zero naming `shimmer` and observed 55 versus 56; then `git -C /tmp/rnr-spike checkout -- . && pnpm --filter @rnr-ai-elements/docs build` exits 0.
